mechanismOfAction.summary: Thrombospondin-1 mimic; activates latent TGF-β to increase collagen.
mechanismOfAction.description: Palmitoylated tripeptide (Pal-Lys-Val-Lys) mimicking thrombospondin-1's TGF-β-activating sequence. Converts latent TGF-β to its active form, stimulating dermal collagen synthesis.
